strings.Vergleicht alle geschützten Windows-Date: Compares all protected Windows files with the component store and replaces modified or damaged ones. Always run AFTER the image repair.
strings.Wie \"prüfen und reparieren\", ändert ab: Like "Check and repair", but changes nothing - only shows whether protected Windows files are damaged.
strings.Liest die Windows-Protokolldatei CBS.log: Reads the Windows log file CBS.log and lists which files SFC could and couldn't repair in the last run.
strings.Auswertung der [SR]-Zeilen in %windir%\\: Analysis of the [SR] lines in %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log (Repairing/Repaired file, Cannot repair member file, Could not reproject)
strings.Zeigt, wie groß der Ordner WinSxS wirkli: Shows how big the WinSxS folder really is (much of it is only linked), how many old packages can be removed and whether a cleanup is recommended.
strings.Entfernt ersetzte Versionen von Windows-: Removes superseded versions of Windows components left over after updates. Installed updates can still be uninstalled.
strings.Löscht zusätzlich alle ersetzten Version: Also permanently deletes all superseded versions. Saves the most space - but already installed updates can NO longer be uninstalled afterwards.
strings.Wenn Windows nach einem Update in der Sc: If Windows is stuck in the "Undoing changes" loop after an update: pending actions can only be safely reverted from the Recovery Environment. Shows the instructions and starts WinRE if you want.
strings.Änderungen werden rückgängig gemacht: Undoing changes made to your computer
strings.In WinRE > Problembehandlung > Erweitert: In WinRE > Troubleshoot > Advanced options > Command Prompt:  dism /Image:C:\ /Cleanup-Image /RevertPendingActions  (check the drive letter in WinRE first with "dir C:\Windows")
strings.Stoppt die Update-Dienste, legt Software: Stops the update services, recreates SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 (the old ones are kept as a backup), clears the BITS queue and resets the BITS and Windows Update permissions to default if they've been altered. The update history in Settings will be empty afterwards.
strings.net stop wuauserv, bits, cryptsvc, msise: net stop wuauserv, bits, cryptsvc, msiserver, usosvc, dosvc | ren %windir%\SoftwareDistribution and System32\catroot2 (*.bak_timestamp) | del qmgr*.dat | sc sdshow/sdset bits and wuauserv (only if different, default SDDL) | netsh winhttp reset proxy | net start  (re-registering old DLLs via regsvr32 has had no effect since Windows 10 and is skipped)
strings.sc sdshow/sdset bits und wuauserv (nur b: sc sdshow/sdset bits and wuauserv (only if different, default SDDL)
strings.net start (das Neuregistrieren alter DL: net start  (re-registering old DLLs via regsvr32 has had no effect since Windows 10 and is skipped)
strings.Prüft, ob Windows auf einen Neustart war: Checks whether Windows is waiting for a restart (restart flags, pending.xml, pending file renames) and names the safe way forward. Changes nothing.
strings.Löscht den Zwischenspeicher, über den Wi: Deletes the cache Windows uses to share update parts with other PCs. Helps with downloads stuck at a certain percentage.
strings.Startet die eingebaute Problembehandlung: Starts Microsoft's built-in troubleshooter without prompts. If it was removed in newer Windows 11 versions, the log says so - then use "Settings > Troubleshoot" (tile next to it).
strings.Öffnet \"Einstellungen > System > Proble: Opens "Settings > System > Troubleshoot" - this is where Windows 11 runs the current troubleshooters for Windows Update and network.
strings.Windows Update sucht sofort neu nach Upd: Windows Update immediately checks for updates again - useful as the last step after a reset.
strings.Einstellungen > System > Wiederherstellu: Settings > System > Recovery > "Fix problems using Windows Update": downloads the installed Windows version again and installs it over the top. Programs, files and settings are kept. Requires internet and takes about an hour.
strings.Liest die Setup-Protokolle des letzten F: Reads the setup logs of the last feature update attempt (ScanResult.xml, setuperr.log, setupact.log) and names the reason: hard-blocking programs (e.g. old VMware), unsigned/blocking drivers, third-party antivirus (wsc:wica) and the setup error code in plain language. Also checks installed upgrade blockers and active third-party antivirus. Changes nothing.
strings.ScanResult.xml (Program BlockingType=Har: ScanResult.xml (Program BlockingType=Hard, DriverPackage BlockMigration=True) | setuperr.log (0xC1900208/0xC1900101 ...) | setupact.log (wsc:wica reports HardBlock) | SecurityCenter2 AntiVirusProduct | Uninstall list (VMware/VirtualBox)
strings.Hängendes Setup lösen (\"andere Instanz: Release stuck Setup ("another instance is running")
strings.Hilft, wenn Windows meldet \"Windows Set: Helps when Windows reports "Windows Setup can't start while another instance is already running" or when an update or repair install won't start. Ends stuck setup processes (SetupHost, setupprep, WindowsUpdateBox, Setup from ~BT/~WS). Only use this when NO intended feature update is currently running.
strings.Windows Setup kann nicht gestartet werde: Windows Setup can't start while another instance is already running
strings.Stop-Process SetupHost, setupprep, Windo: Stop-Process SetupHost, setupprep, WindowsUpdateBox, setup (only from Setup path) ; then restart
strings.Entfernt bekannte alte, angreifbare Hilf: Removes known old, vulnerable helper drivers that Windows has put on the blocklist and that trigger the message "A driver can't load on this device" at startup (e.g. iqvw64e.sys, Intel Ethernet diagnostics). Removes the driver package, service and file - with backup. Devices keep working with the standard Windows drivers.
strings.Ein Treiber kann auf diesem Gerät nicht: A driver can't load on this device
strings.Schreibt vor jeder Änderung den komplett: Before any change, writes the complete current state to a text file: addresses, bindings, filter drivers, Winsock, services, DHCP events and the state of the filtering platform. Changes nothing.
strings.ipconfig /all | netsh int ipv4 show conf: ipconfig /all | netsh int ipv4 show config | route print -4 | Get-NetAdapterBinding -AllBindings | pnputil /enum-drivers /class NetService | netsh winsock show catalog | netsh wfp show state | DHCP client events
strings.Vergleicht Starttyp, Programmpfad und Ab: Compares the startup type, program path and dependencies of 20 network services and drivers (DHCP Client, DNS, NSI, TCP/IP, AFD, NDIS, Firewall, WLAN, Connection Manager, WinHTTP auto-proxy ...) with the Windows 11 defaults and resets only values that differ. PC-Tools shows the differences first.
strings.Prüft je WLAN- und LAN-Adapter, ob IPv4: Checks each Wi-Fi and Ethernet adapter to see whether IPv4 is turned on, whether DHCP is on and whether old static addresses are still stored - and switches everything to automatic where that's not the case.
strings.Der Wert DisabledComponents schaltet Tei: The DisabledComponents value turns off parts of IPv6 or prefers IPv4. Some tuning programs set it incorrectly - which then also disrupts IPv4. Sets it to 0 (Windows default).
strings.Kommt auf die Adress-Anfrage keine Antwo: If there's no reply to the address request, Windows automatically asks again with the broadcast bit switched. Helps with routers and access points that ignore one of the two variants.
strings.Schaltet an allen echten Adaptern die Bi: Turns off the binding of other vendors' filters and protocols on all physical adapters (antivirus such as Panda, VPN, packet capture, virtualization). Antivirus filters are one of the most common causes of "DHCP request goes out, but no reply comes back". Undo in the filter list below.
strings.DHCP-Anfrage geht raus, aber keine Antwo: DHCP request goes out, but no reply comes back
strings.Get-NetAdapterBinding -AllBindings | ? C: Get-NetAdapterBinding -AllBindings | ? ComponentID -notmatch "^(ms_|vms_)" | Disable-NetAdapterBinding (list as JSON in data folder)
strings.Disable-NetAdapterBinding (Liste als JSO: Disable-NetAdapterBinding (list as JSON in data folder)
strings.Entfernt Geräteeinträge von Netzwerkadap: Removes device entries of network adapters that no longer exist (old USB adapters, Hyper-V and VPN leftovers). Such ghost adapters can block names, settings and bindings.
strings.Entfernt WLAN- und LAN-Adapter aus der G: Removes Wi-Fi and Ethernet adapters from Device Manager and has Windows detect them again right away. The driver is loaded fresh and all adapter settings are back to default. The connection drops briefly.
strings.Setzt den Systemproxy (WinHTTP - benutzt: Resets the system proxy (WinHTTP - used by Windows Update and services) and the user's proxy. Malware and old company settings often leave leftovers here.
strings.Vergisst gemerkte Namen und Hardwareadre: Forgets cached names and hardware addresses on the network. Helps when websites or devices are looked for at old addresses.
strings.Gibt alle IPv4-Adressen frei und fordert: Releases all IPv4 addresses and requests them again from the router. The connection is briefly interrupted.
strings.Schreibt die IPv4-Einstellungen in der R: Rewrites the IPv4 settings in the registry. Static IP addresses are lost. What was changed is recorded in a log file in the data folder.
strings.Setzt die IPv6-Einstellungen, Routen und: Resets IPv6 settings, routes and prefix policies to default.
strings.Setzt den Winsock-Katalog auf Standard u: Resets the Winsock catalog to default and removes hooked-in third-party modules (LSPs) from antivirus, VPN or adware.
strings.Filterplattform sichern und neu starten: Back up and restart filtering platform
strings.Über die Windows-Filterplattform (WFP) p: Firewall and antivirus check every packet through the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP). PC-Tools backs up its state as evidence and restarts the Base Filtering Engine and firewall. The filters themselves can only be deleted via "Firewall to default" or by removing the antivirus.
strings.Löscht alle eigenen und von Programmen a: Deletes all firewall rules created by you or by programs and restores the Windows default. A backup is exported first. Programs will ask for permission again afterwards.
strings.Wie \"Einstellungen > Netzwerkzurücksetz: Like "Settings > Network reset": all network adapters and components are removed and reinstalled on restart, and TCP/IP, IPv6, Winsock and proxy are reset as well. VPN programs and virtual switches may need to be set up again afterwards.
strings.netsh int ip reset ; netsh int ipv6 rese: netsh int ip reset ; netsh int ipv6 reset ; netsh winsock reset ; netsh winhttp reset proxy ; netcfg -d  (then restart)
strings.Verwaiste Switch-Bindungen, WinNAT, Inte: Orphaned switch bindings, WinNAT, Internet Connection Sharing and the hypervisor are checked and repaired on the Network Diagnostics page - the button takes you straight there.
strings.Seite Netzwerk-Diagnose > Hyper-V (Get-V: Network Diagnostics page > Hyper-V (Get-VMSwitch, vms_pp binding, winnat, hns, SharedAccess, bcdedit hypervisorlaunchtype)
strings.Sichert die Startkonfiguration (BCD) in: Backs up the boot configuration (BCD) to the data folder and writes all entries in readable form to a text file.
strings.Bindet die versteckte EFI-Systempartitio: Briefly mounts the hidden EFI system partition and rewrites the boot manager and boot configuration with bcdboot (automatic backup first, BitLocker is suspended for one restart). Helps with "Bootmgr is missing" or a missing Windows entry.
strings.Zeigt, ob WinRE (Starthilfe, Zurücksetze: Shows whether WinRE (Startup Repair, Reset, System Restore at startup) is turned on and where it's located.
strings.Schaltet WinRE ein. Fehlt die Datei Winr: Turns on WinRE. If the Winre.wim file is missing, PC-Tools gets it from the repair source (Windows ISO above) and registers it again.
strings.reagentc /enable ; bei fehlender Winre.w: reagentc /enable ; if Winre.wim is missing: install.wim\Windows\System32\Recovery\Winre.wim > C:\Windows\System32\Recovery ; reagentc /setreimage /path C:\Windows\System32\Recovery ; reagentc /enable
strings.Startet den PC sofort neu in die Windows: Immediately restarts the PC into the Windows Recovery Environment (Troubleshoot, Startup Repair, Command Prompt, System Restore).
strings.Neustart in das blaue Menü \"Option ausw: Restarts into the blue "Choose an option" menu - like Shift + Restart. There you'll also find UEFI Firmware Settings and Startup Settings.
strings.Startet Windows einmal nur mit Grundtrei: Starts Windows once with basic drivers only (optionally with networking). After you sign in to safe mode, PC-Tools turns it off again automatically, so the startup after that is normal again.
strings.Nimmt einen gesetzten abgesicherten Star: Immediately undoes a set safe boot - the next startup is normal again.
strings.Beim nächsten Start schreibt Windows jed: At the next startup, Windows writes every loaded and not loaded driver to C:\Windows\ntbtlog.txt - ideal for finding a driver that hangs.
strings.Schaltet das Startprotokoll wieder aus (: Turns the boot log off again (the file ntbtlog.txt is kept).
strings.Prüft das Dateisystem im laufenden Betri: Checks the file system while Windows is running and fixes minor errors right away. Larger errors are scheduled for the next startup.
strings.Merkt eine gründliche Prüfung mit Repara: Schedules a thorough check with repair and surface scan for the next startup. Depending on the drive, this can take 30 to 120 minutes - don't turn off the PC!
strings.chkdsk C: /f /r (Rückfrage mit J/Y beant: chkdsk C: /f /r (prompt answered with J/Y) ; chkntfs C:
strings.Zeigt, ob Laufwerk C: als fehlerhaft mar: Shows whether drive C: is marked as faulty and whether a check is scheduled at startup. Changes nothing.
strings.Meldet alle Apps des Benutzers neu bei W: Re-registers all of the user's apps with Windows (Settings, Photos, Calculator, Store ...). Helps when apps close immediately or won't start at all.
strings.Wie oben, aber für alle auf dem PC berei: Like above, but for all system and Store apps provisioned on the PC (other users' apps are also re-registered for this user). Takes a few minutes.
strings.Leert den Store-Zwischenspeicher und set: Clears the Store cache and resets the Store app in the background. Helps with stuck downloads and sign-in errors in the Store.
strings.Startmenü, Taskleiste und Suche reparier: Repair Start menu, taskbar and search
strings.Registriert die Windows-Oberfläche (Star: Re-registers the Windows interface (Start menu, shell, search, client core) and restarts it.
Add-AppxPackage -Register for Microsoft.Windows.StartMenuExperienceHost, ShellExperienceHost, Windows.Search, MicrosoftWindows.Client.CBS/Core ; restart Explorer
strings.Stoppt die Windows-Suche, löscht den Ind: Stops Windows Search, deletes the index (Windows.edb/Windows.db) and rebuilds it. Search will be slower for a while until everything has been indexed again.
strings.Bei leeren, falschen oder alten Symbolen: For blank, wrong or outdated icons and thumbnails. File Explorer restarts briefly for this.
strings.Explorer beenden ; del %LOCALAPPDATA%\\I: Stop Explorer ; del %LOCALAPPDATA%\IconCache.db, ...\Explorer\iconcache_*.db, thumbcache_*.db ; start Explorer
strings.Bei falsch oder gar nicht dargestellten: For fonts that display incorrectly or not at all. Takes full effect after a restart.
strings.net stop FontCache ; del %windir%\\Servi: net stop FontCache ; del %windir%\ServiceProfiles\LocalService\AppData\Local\FontCache\* and System32\FNTCACHE.DAT ; net start FontCache
strings.Beendet Taskleiste und Explorer und star: Ends the taskbar and File Explorer and restarts them cleanly with normal user rights.
taskkill /f /im explorer.exe ; explorer.exe (via a task as the signed-in user)
strings.Wenn winget keine Programme mehr findet: When winget no longer finds programs or stops with source errors.
strings.WMI liefert Systeminformationen an Windo: WMI provides system information to Windows and many programs. A repair is only done if the check finds errors - otherwise everything stays as it is.
strings.Wenn Task-Manager, Leistungsüberwachung: When Task Manager, Performance Monitor or monitoring programs show empty values.
strings.Schaltet .NET Framework 3.5 (für ältere: Turns on or reinstalls .NET Framework 3.5 (for older programs) - from Windows Update or from the repair source (\sources\sxs of the ISO). .NET 4.8 is part of Windows and is repaired via image repair and SFC.
strings.Öffnet die Microsoft-Seite des offiziell: Opens the Microsoft page for the official .NET Framework Repair Tool - for older Windows versions and stubborn .NET installation errors.
strings.Viele Programme brauchen die Microsoft-V: Many programs need the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime. If it's missing or damaged, they fail with "VCRUNTIME140.dll is missing". Freshly installs x64 and x86.
strings.winget install --id Microsoft.VCRedist.2: winget install --id Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 --exact --force (and .x86, plus .arm64 on ARM)
strings.Löscht die lokalen Richtliniendateien (v: Deletes the local policy files (backup first) and reapplies the policies. Helps with "Some of these settings are managed by your organization" after tuning programs. NOT on company PCs in a domain - there, policies come from the server.
strings.Einige Einstellungen werden von Ihrer Or: Some of these settings are managed by your organization
strings.Löscht hängende Druckaufträge und starte: Deletes stuck print jobs and restarts the print service.
strings.Meldet den Windows-Zeitdienst ab und neu: Unregisters and re-registers the Windows Time service and syncs the clock immediately. A wrong time disrupts sign-ins, certificates and Windows Update.
strings.Setzt die App \"Windows-Sicherheit\" zur: Resets the "Windows Security" app, starts Security Center and gets fresh Defender signatures. Antivirus settings are NOT changed.
strings.Ersetzt die hosts-Datei durch die leere: Replaces the hosts file with the empty Windows template. Your own entries (e.g. for servers on your home network) are backed up alongside it.
strings.Vergleicht den Starttyp von rund 30 Kern: Compares the startup type of about 30 core services (Windows Update, Installer, Event Log, WMI, Task Scheduler, Audio, Print, Search ...) with the Windows default and resets disabled services. The differences are shown first.
strings.Löscht temporäre Dateien aller Benutzer: Deletes temporary files of all users and of Windows that are older than one day. Locked files are left in place.
strings.del %TEMP%\\* (je Benutzerprofil) und %w: del %TEMP%\* (per user profile) and %windir%\Temp\* - older than 1 day
strings.Fehlerübersicht der letzten 7 Tage: Error overview for the last 7 days
strings.Zählt kritische Ereignisse und Fehler im: Counts critical events and errors in the System log by source - quickly shows whether disks, drivers, services or updates are causing trouble. Changes nothing.
strings.Hält den aktuellen Stand von Windows, Tr: Captures the current state of Windows, drivers and registry. Runs automatically before every repair if the checkbox above is selected.
strings.Installiert Windows aus einer ISO über s: Installs Windows over itself from an ISO - programs, files and settings are kept. Fixes almost everything that DISM and SFC can't. Takes you to the card further down.
strings.Setzt Windows, Treiber und Programme auf: Restores Windows, drivers and programs to an earlier restore point. Your personal files are not affected.
strings.Windows neu installieren - mit der Wahl: Reinstall Windows - with the choice "Keep my files" or "Remove everything". Programs must be reinstalled afterwards. Only opens the Windows wizard, which asks again itself.
strings.Für Reparaturquelle und Reparaturinstall: For the repair source and repair install, you need a Windows ISO with the same version, language and edition. The "Windows & Office" page downloads it directly from Microsoft.
strings.In wenigen Minuten, ohne Risiko und ohne: In a few minutes, with no risk and no restart: quick image check, SFC analysis, update status, Delivery Optimization, DNS/ARP/NetBIOS caches, WMI, time service, print queue, temporary files and error overview.
strings.Ändert nichts: Abbild-Schnellprüfung, Sy: Changes nothing: quick image check, system file check, SFC analysis, update status, WinRE, file system and error overview.
strings.Die klassische Reihenfolge der Profis: A: The classic order used by pros: check and repair the image (with ISO source, if selected), then SFC, CBS.log analysis, component store cleanup, drive check, WMI. Takes 30 to 60 minutes.
strings.Zustand prüfen, Update komplett zurückse: Check status, completely reset updates, clear Delivery Optimization, repair image and system files, time service, troubleshooter and new scan - with a restart at the end.
strings.Für \"keine IPv4-Adresse, DHCP-Anfrage o: For "no IPv4 address, DHCP request without reply": save evidence, service defaults, IPv4/DHCP, IPv6 components, broadcast toggle, detach third-party filters, ghost adapters, proxy, caches, TCP/IP, IPv6, Winsock and filtering platform - with a restore point first and a restart at the end. Firewall and network components are left untouched.
strings.keine IPv4-Adresse, DHCP-Anfrage ohne An: no IPv4 address, DHCP request without reply
strings.Store zurücksetzen, Oberfläche und Apps: Reset Store, re-register interface and apps, search index, icon cache and File Explorer.
strings.Startkonfiguration sichern, WinRE prüfen: Back up boot configuration, check and turn on WinRE, check file system - so the PC can still start in an emergency.
strings.WMI, Leistungsindikatoren, Windows-Siche: WMI, performance counters, Windows Security, time service, disabled core services, temporary files and error overview.
strings.Komponentenspeicher analysieren und alte: Analyze the component store and remove old update leftovers (without ResetBase - updates can still be uninstalled).
strings.Jede Reparatur des Katalogs, die sicher: Every repair in the catalog that is safe or only needs a restart - in the right order. Excluded are all deep interventions (firewall, netcfg, ResetBase, boot files, Group Policy, hosts), the check on restart and the boot log switches. Takes 1 to 2 hours, restart at the end.
Gets the IPv4 address from the router.

strings.Grundlage von Firewall und Filterplattfo: Foundation of the firewall and filtering platform.
DHCP Client and DNS depend on it.

strings.Version 13.9: Der KI-Assistent arbeitet: Version 13.9: The AI Assistant now works on its own: free AI with one click (or automatically on first send), automatic diagnosis in plain words after every maintenance run, a weekly summary "What happened on your PC this week?", explanations of blue screens (minidumps with stop code) and the event log, AI summary of the network report with a list of actions by priority, new read tools (startup, drivers, updates - always only after confirmation), voice input and read-aloud, saving the conversation per PC and memory of earlier problems.

Key and model are kept separately for each provider. "Unused programs" can now be set from 5 days. Plus stability: service actions, network drives, update checks and status messages can no longer block PC-Tools endlessly.

From now on, updates come from the public repository (stable branch, downloads under Releases); a GitHub token is no longer needed. Existing installations are switched over automatically.
strings.Version 13.7: Neu \"Nicht genutzte Progr: Version 13.7: New "Unused programs" (Overview and PC Cleaner > Programs): finds programs that haven't been started for 90 days to 2 years (Windows traces Prefetch, BAM and UserAssist), protects runtimes, drivers, security, backup, VPN, remote support, Office and printer programs and silently removes the checked ones one after another after ONE confirmation - with restore point, leftovers (folders to the Recycle Bin, registry with backup) and orphaned shortcuts. Ninite Pro is no longer part of the download - if you have a license, copy NinitePro.exe to C:\ProgramData\PCPflege (instructions: Ninite-Pro-einbinden.txt).
strings.Version 13.6: Netzwerk dokumentieren erk: Version 13.6: Document Network now detects the entire network infrastructure - routers (including additional routers and double NAT), firewalls (Sophos, Fortinet, pfSense/OPNsense, Securepoint, Zyxel, LANCOM ...), switches, access points (UniFi, Omada, Aruba, LANCOM, MikroTik, FRITZ!Repeater, mesh ...) and Wi-Fi controllers. Sources: manufacturer, web interface, UPnP, SNMP (model, firmware, location, contact, uptime), management ports and the Wi-Fi radios that match the device MAC. New report chapter "Network infrastructure" with Wi-Fi coverage per access point and the path to the internet; new findings: SNMP with default community, additional router, double NAT.
strings.Version 13.5: Zwei neue Seiten. \"WLAN o: Version 13.5: Two new pages. "Optimize Wi-Fi": analysis of connection, signal (dBm), band, channel, wireless standard, security, neighboring networks, power saving and the hidden driver settings, with a rating; "Optimize Wi-Fi" sets power saving, 5/6 GHz preference, transmit power, MIMO, channel width, wireless standard and roaming with a backup (Undo); stability test, reconnect Wi-Fi, Windows Wi-Fi report and the Wi-Fi walkthrough (measure signal per room). "Document Network": records all devices (type, IP, MAC, manufacturer, 59 services, web interface, connection), smart home and building automation (KNX IP with Secure check and passive bus monitor, Bonjour/mDNS, UPnP, Shelly, Tasmota, Hue, Node-RED, MQTT, Homematic, ESPHome, Matter/Thread, Home Assistant via token), routers and - with sign-in - the FRITZ!Box (all devices, even offline, port forwarding, WPS, guest network, remote access, FRITZ!OS update, DSL values), reachability from the internet (port forwarding, UPnP, remote access, carrier-grade NAT, IPv6, Shodan InternetDB with CVEs), Wi-Fi and this PC. Rates vulnerabilities (critical to info, grade A-E), compares with the last scan, saves room/purpose/note per device, exports as an Excel list and creates a PDF report with logo, network map, inventory, vulnerabilities, action plan and approval/signature field. Optionally runs automatically every Monday with an alert for new devices or vulnerabilities.
strings.Version 13.4: Zwei neue Ein-Klick-Knöpfe: Version 13.4: Two new one-click buttons on the Overview. "All optimizations" turns on all settings on the Tuning page (performance, privacy, File Explorer and taskbar, system) - with restore point, before list and log. "Startup: only what's needed" reduces startup apps to security, driver helpers, PC-Tools and pinned programs (undo in the startup manager).
strings.Version 13.3.2: Funktionsupdates (neue W: Version 13.3.2: Feature updates (new Windows versions) and - if the PC is in the Insider Program - the latest Insider builds are now installed via Windows Update by default, including in one-click maintenance. Existing installations are switched over once. If you don't want this: turn on Settings > "Exclude feature updates and Insider builds".
strings.Funktionsupdates und Insider-Builds auss: Exclude feature updates and Insider builds
strings.Version 13.3.1: Windows Update installie: Version 13.3.1: Windows Update now also installs updates that Microsoft marks as "may request input" (typically: Intel graphics, system and extension drivers). Until now they were left out as "skipped (needs input)". Now they are installed separately and silently; only if one really needs input does that one fail, and the log tells you what to do.
strings.Version 13.3: Neu auf der Seite Fehler b: Version 13.3: New on the Troubleshoot page: "Devices with problems (Device Manager)". Shows all devices with an exclamation mark and the reason (no driver, error code, disabled). "Repair" removes orphaned software entries whose driver was deleted (e.g. an old TAP/VPN adapter as "Unknown device") and turns off Bluetooth services without a driver for their paired device (e.g. Samsung phone/tablet under "Other devices") - simply deleting doesn't help there, the entries come right back. If turning them off doesn't work, "Devices and Printers" opens with instructions.
strings.Version 13.2: Neu auf der Seite Fehler b: Version 13.2: New on the Troubleshoot page: "Store apps that won't start". Finds apps like the new Outlook that are registered after a major Windows update but whose program folder is missing (then the app doesn't start and resetting doesn't help). Also checks for damaged app runtimes (Windows App Runtime) and WebView2 - old damaged versions with an intact newer one next to them are recognized as harmless. "Repair" removes broken Store apps, opens their Store page for reinstalling and reinstalls broken runtimes or WebView2 via winget.
strings.Version 13.1.4: Die neue Dienstgruppen-P: Version 13.1.4: The new service group check wrongly reported the copies that Windows creates per user for some services (name ends e.g. in _b270d) as "not in any service group". These are now checked using the name of their template. As a result, the network services check also reliably detects a misconfigured Network List Service (netprofm).
strings.Version 13.1.3: Wichtige Korrektur - die: Version 13.1.3: Important fix - the check "Network services to Windows default" forced a hard-coded, outdated service group for services such as WinHTTP Web Proxy Auto-Discovery. On newer Windows versions, the service then never starts (hangs permanently in "Starting"), and without it Connection Manager and Wi-Fi don't work. Now the correct group is read from the respective Windows itself. New: "Services that won't start" detects wrong or missing service groups (MISCONFIGURED), and "Repair" corrects them with a backup. PCs that were already misconfigured are set right again.
strings.Version 13.1.2: \"Dienste, die nicht sta: Version 13.1.2: "Services that won't start" - the output is now light and easy to read (previously very dark), and below the box there's a "Copy log" button that copies the entire content to the clipboard.
strings.Version 13.1.1: Fehler behoben - \"Diens: Version 13.1.1: Bug fixed - "Services that won't start" showed nothing while checking and repairing, and the process seemed to hang for minutes. Cause: both functions tried to start every service with a blocking start command (up to 30 seconds per service), and the display was only updated at the very end. Now: "Check" only diagnoses (doesn't start any services) and finishes in seconds; "Repair" starts the services without blocking and with a fixed time limit (usually under a minute).
strings.Version 13.1: Neue Hilfe \"Dienste, die: Version 13.1: New help "Services that won't start" (Troubleshoot page): finds all services with startup type Automatic that aren't running and names the CAUSE (waiting for another service, program file missing, disabled, wrong account, error code). "Repair" sets the core services to the Windows default, starts dependencies in the right order and starts the services. Services that only start when needed (trigger) are recognized as normal. Good for PCs/Surfaces where services get stuck.
strings.Version 13.0.1: Fehler behoben - der Win: Version 13.0.1: Bug fixed - the Windows Installation/Update Assistant (Microsoft.WindowsInstallationAssistant and others) was also updated via winget during "Update programs" and launched an OS upgrade dialog that hung. These upgrade assistants are now permanently skipped (pinned) and no longer appear in the installer.
strings.Version 13.0: Neuer Bereich Server-Tools: Version 13.0: New Server Tools section (appears automatically on Windows Server; on normal PCs it can be turned on under Settings > Server mode - then optionally with PowerShell remoting): server and role overview, Active Directory health (dcdiag, replication, FSMO, time, DNS), AD accounts and groups (locked/inactive accounts, expiring passwords, privileged groups, GPO, unlock account), Azure/Entra (hybrid join, Entra Connect Sync, Azure reachability) as well as maintenance and hardening (certificates, SMBv1/LDAP/NTLM check, Windows Server Backup).
strings.Version 13.0: Netzwerk-Werkzeuge mit Por: Version 13.0: Network Tools with port scanner and security scan - scans a computer or an entire network (single IP, range, subnet, several separated by commas) for open ports (from the most important up to all 65535) and checks devices found for risky services (SMBv1, Telnet, FTP, RDP, VNC, open databases, SNMP ...) with rating and recommendation. Only for your own networks.
strings.Version 12.5: Großes Update. Neu: \"Alle: Version 12.5: Big update. New: "Everything automatic" on the home page - detects problems on its own (services, Windows Update, network, WMI, file system), fixes them and fully optimizes the PC, without any questions (intended for beginners). New "Ultimate performance" button (Ultimate Performance, effects/animations off, power saving and unnecessary startup apps off). Windows 11 26H2 as target, plus "Allow Windows 11 without TPM/Secure Boot" and the "not supported" notices/watermark permanently off (Update Control). Now detects device type and system precisely (client/server, desktop/notebook/tablet/server/VM, brand) and runs on Windows 10 and Windows Server 2012-2025. Faster startup with loading indicator. Open source info area with source code, checksum, privacy notice and "Report a bug".
strings.Version 12.5: Treiber für alle Geräte (K: Version 12.5: Drivers for all devices (camera, printer, USB, sound ...) come via Windows Update - if the manufacturer catalog doesn't work (e.g. HP), it automatically falls back to Windows Update. Manufacturer catalog is unpacked more robustly. UAC turned off and missing backup no longer count as a security PROBLEM but as a recommendation. Full Backup detects installed backup programs and recommends free ones. Dark mode: hard-to-read spots (light boxes) fixed.
strings.Version 12.1: BitLocker mit einem Klick: Version 12.1: BitLocker with one click - on the Security page, "Encrypt C: with one click" encrypts the Windows drive and automatically saves the recovery key in its own folder ("BitLocker-Schluessel") in the PC-Tools data folder - with a note file saying the key must also be backed up outside the PC. PC-Tools opens the folder directly; "Open key folder" takes you there at any time.
strings.Version 12.0: Neuer durchsuchbarer Insta: Version 12.0: New searchable installer - the Install page now has online search via winget and Chocolatey (tens of thousands of programs). Choose a source at the top, type a term, press Enter, check and install. All sources (Ninite if available, winget, Chocolatey) complement each other automatically: if a program is missing in one source, the other takes over. All free.
strings.Version 11.5: Programm-Updates aus mehre: Version 11.5: Program updates from several free sources - Chocolatey (10,000+ packages) runs alongside winget and Ninite, the sources serve as fallbacks for each other; new buttons for UniGetUI and Patch My PC Home
strings.Version 11.0: Windows-Update-Doktor und: Version 11.0: Windows Update doctor and complete repair - finds and resolves blocks on feature updates (incompatible programs/drivers like VMware, old network filters), plus the in-depth complete repair via batch file with a detailed super log
strings.PC-Tools ist Open Source und kostenlos -: PC-Tools is open source and free - the source code is publicly available on GitHub (Apache 2.0 license). Anyone may review, use and share the program.
strings.Version 10.0.1: Microsoft Surface - alle: Version 10.0.1: Microsoft Surface - all variants of the driver and firmware package as a list (Windows version, build, version, size, fits/recommended); the selected variant is downloaded or installed
strings.Version 10.0: Große neue Version - Auswa: Version 10.0: Major new version - choice of Lite or full version at first start, PC Cleaner (like CCleaner), Full Backup with recovery package, AI Assistant (Claude), one-click optimization with before/after report, driver and BIOS backup before updates, Battery & Power, remote support dashboard in My PCs
strings.Version 10.0: Neue Seite Komplettsicheru: Version 10.0: New Full Backup page - regular system image of the whole PC (Windows Backup) to an external hard drive or NAS with live progress, plain-language explanations of error codes, verification of every backup (optionally with mounted image), versions and retention, its own schedule (weekly/monthly, wake, only on AC power, catch up), phone notification, recovery package at the destination, automatic refresh of the Rescue USB, single files from the image and menu item S (restore system image) in the repair menu
strings.Version 10.0: Neue Seite PC-Reiniger (Be: Version 10.0: New PC Cleaner page (Maintenance section) - cleaning at CCleaner Professional level: Edge, Chrome, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera and Firefox in all profiles (cache, code/GPU/shader cache, download history, optionally history, cookies with exception list, session and form data - never passwords), over 20 programs (Office, Teams, Discord, Spotify, Steam, Epic, Battle.net, shader caches, Adobe, VS Code, JetBrains, Zoom, WhatsApp ...), Windows traces; analysis with chart, profiles Safe/Thorough/Privacy/Custom, optionally in automatic maintenance. Plus careful registry cleaning with .reg backup, uninstalling programs with leftover search, browser extensions and home page check, context menu manager, third-party scheduled tasks and securely wiping free space (cipher /w, TRIM for SSDs)
strings.Version 10.0: Ein-Klick-Optimierung auf: Version 10.0: One-click optimization on the Overview - a round button measures the health score, sets a restore point, cleans up, installs Windows, driver and program updates, optimizes, checks system files, security and backup and then shows a before/after report (also as PDF) with a jump to every open recommendation; progress right on the card, optionally as automatic maintenance
strings.Version 10.0: Treiber- und BIOS-Sicherun: Version 10.0: Driver and BIOS backup before updates - before every driver, BIOS or firmware update (Windows Update, NVIDIA, Intel, HP, Lenovo, Dell, Surface, driver packages), all drivers are backed up with device list and BIOS version; afterwards the Drivers page shows what changed and restores individual devices or the entire state
strings.Version 10.0: Neue Seite Akku und Energi: Version 10.0: New Battery & Power page - battery health with capacity history and wear forecast, "What's draining the battery?" (power use per program), energy analysis in plain language, sleep diagnostics (what keeps the PC awake, what wakes it at night, sleep analysis), power plans and Windows 11 power mode, charge limit for HP/Dell directly and Lenovo/Surface with instructions, UPS detection and power-saving tips for desktop PCs
strings.Version 10.0: Meine PCs wird zum Fernwar: Version 10.0: My PCs becomes a remote support dashboard - live overview with online detection (heartbeat every 10 minutes), sortable list of all PCs with health score, restart needed, pending updates, backup and Full Backup, jobs to several PCs at once (new: self-test, Rescue USB status, Full Backup, restart with message and delay), job history, detail view with score history and log, problem alerts without duplicate messages and a job key to secure remote jobs
strings.Version 10.0: KI-Assistent - Claude bean: Version 10.0: AI Assistant - Claude answers questions about your PC and PC-Tools in plain words, explains logs and error messages and suggests suitable actions (only after your confirmation). With your own Anthropic API key directly in the program (stored encrypted, usage counter and monthly limit) or without a key via "Ask in Claude.ai". You decide which PC info is sent along. "Assistant" button at the bottom of the status bar and Ctrl+Shift+A on every page.
strings.Version 9.3: Stabiler - neue Versionen w: Version 9.3: More stable - new versions are checked before installation, the previous version is backed up and automatically restored if there are startup problems; settings are saved fail-safe; schedule and interface never start tasks at the same time; errors in the interface are caught and logged. New: self-test, "Roll back to previous version", update delay (test PC first) and Lite view (Settings > Stability)
strings.Version 9.2.1: Automatischer Voll-Lauf r: Version 9.2.1: Before Windows Update, the automatic full run frees up the system partition (EFI/System Reserved) when less than 30 MB is free there - fixes "We couldn't update the system reserved partition"; removed files are backed up in the data folder under ESP-Sicherung
strings.Version 9.2: Notfall-Stick lädt automati: Version 9.2: Rescue USB automatically downloads the latest official Windows 11 ISO from Microsoft (boots on any PC, even with Secure Boot) and puts the ISO and a repair source (install.esd with edition list) on the exFAT data partition - the repair menu finds the source for DISM on its own; the data partition is now set up with format.com and automatically retried if there are problems
strings.Version 9.1: Toolbox fest eingebaut - di: Version 9.1: Toolbox built in - the tools are loaded automatically in the background at startup and kept up to date (without blocking other tasks, and for all PCs via the shared folder from My PCs); Health score: fixed storage for large drives, security score, USB drives and crash count
strings.Version 9.1: Neue Seite Windows-Reparatu: Version 9.1: New Windows Repair page - more than 70 repairs in one place (DISM with ISO source, SFC with CBS.log analysis, full Windows Update reset, deep network repair with service comparison against Windows 11, detect and remove NDIS filters from antivirus/VPN such as Panda, IPv4/IPv6 registration, WinRE, boot files, safe mode, apps, WMI, .NET, Visual C++, Group Policy), Repair Assistant with profiles, background runs with history, repair install (in-place upgrade) with ISO check, and text mode Windows-Reparatur.cmd for the USB drive
strings.Version 9.0: Neuer Bereich WERKZEUGE mit: Version 9.0: New TOOLS section with seven new pages - Toolbox, Hardware Test, Network Tools, Rescue USB, Remote Help, Device Record and Software Kiosk - plus the health score on the Overview and a redesigned interface
strings.Version 9.0: Toolbox - 25 bewährte Admin: Version 9.0: Toolbox - 25 proven admin and diagnostic tools (Sysinternals, CPU-Z, HWiNFO, CrystalDiskInfo, Rufus, Ventoy, PuTTY, RustDesk ...) at the push of a button, always the latest version straight from the developer, with signature check and optionally on the USB drive; Software Kiosk - install programs like in an app store by role (Office, Front desk, Checkout, Development, Graphics, Family, Gaming, Admin), save, export and import your own roles, plus winget search
strings.Programme wie im App-Store: Programs like in an app store
strings.Version 9.0: Neue Seite Hardware-Test -: Version 9.0: New Hardware Test page - memory, disks (read test with speed curve), CPU stress test with clock/temperature chart and throttling detection, battery with real runtime measurement, screen pixel test with pixel fixer, keyboard and touch/pen test - and finally a test report as PDF with signature lines
strings.Version 9.0: Zustands-Score auf der Über: Version 9.0: Health score on the Overview - a value from 0 to 100 based on security, updates, storage, disks, battery, stability, startup time, devices and temperature, with trend, 90-day history and a phone notification when it drops
strings.Version 9.0: neue Seite Notfall-Stick (b: Version 9.0: New Rescue USB page (bootable repair drive with the PC's recovery environment, repair menu, file rescue, driver backup), new Remote Help page (help package with phone notification, Quick Assist, RustDesk, TeamViewer, AnyDesk with signature check)
strings.Version 9.0: Neue Seite Netzwerk-Werkzeu: Version 9.0: New Network Tools page - all devices on the network with manufacturer and "new" tag, Wake-on-LAN, speed test history with chart (LAN/Wi-Fi), DNS comparison with recommendation, Wi-Fi channel planner (2.4 and 5 GHz) and router check with FRITZ!OS version and UPnP port forwards
strings.Version 9.0: Neue Seite Geräte-Akte - Ha: Version 9.0: New Device Record page - hardware, serial number, warranty, battery and health history automatically, plus purchase data, inventory number, location, maintenance log, invoices/photos and record as PDF; location and owner appear in "My PCs"
strings.Version 8.1: Updates werden beim Start a: Version 8.1: Updates are installed automatically at startup - with progress display (file, size, speed, checksum) and restart of PC-Tools; if maintenance, a driver or a repair needs a restart, PC-Tools offers it right away (now, in 10 minutes or later with a reminder)
strings.Version 8.0: Aus PC-Pflege wird PC-Tools: Version 8.0: PC-Pflege becomes PC-Tools - new name, new logo (monitor with chip and wrench). Settings, schedules, update path and everything else stay the same; shortcuts are renamed automatically
strings.Version 7.9: \"Mit neuer MAC testen\" (z: Version 7.9: "Test with new MAC" (shows whether the router refuses an address only to this device), "Restore original MAC", detect and clean up duplicate network profiles (Network 2, 3, 4 ...), more precise results in the DHCP live test
strings.Version 7.8: DHCP-Live-Test (30 s) mit P: Version 7.8: DHCP live test (30 s) with packet capture - shows whether the PC is asking, whether a DHCP server answers and whether other devices also get no address, detects network and router, and optionally sets a free static IP; deep analysis now evaluates the capture correctly (including German pktmon output)
strings.Version 7.7: Netzwerk-Tiefenanalyse - sa: Version 7.7: Deep network analysis - collects all network data, a live test with DHCP packet capture (pktmon), a separate DHCP probe to the router, WFP filters and dropped packets, registry and events into one ZIP file with automatic analysis (Network Diagnostics, text mode key T, Netzwerk-Tiefenanalyse.cmd on the USB drive)
strings.Version 7.6: Treiber-Seite \"Problem beh: Version 7.6: Drivers page "Fix problem" (USB Code 10: power saving off, restart hub and device, redetect, manufacturer from VID/PID; remove ghost devices), PS/2 port without device (Code 24) is treated as harmless, hide your own devices as harmless; driver cleanup no longer deletes newer driver packages
strings.Version 7.5: Netzwerk-Diagnose erkennt H: Version 7.5: Network Diagnostics detects Hyper-V problems (orphaned switch binding, switch not shared with the PC, vEthernet without IPv4, DHCP port 68 in use, ports reserved by WinNAT, ICS) and fixes them: detach adapter from switch, delete switch, restart WinNAT, hypervisor test, reset Hyper-V network - also in network emergency text mode (key H)
strings.Version 7.4.1: Programm-Updates mit dens: Version 7.4.1: Program updates with the same fallbacks as installation (HWiNFO directly from the developer, reinstall PowerToys if installed differently), no unnecessary follow-up run, no false restart notice after HP drivers
strings.Version 7.4: Korrekturen aus dem Protoko: Version 7.4: Fixes from the log - winget no longer reads footer lines as a program ("ierungen"), HWiNFO and other manufacturer downloads load like a browser (bypasses 403 blocks, new download sources), Lenovo Thin Installer no longer reports a false "successful"
strings.Version 7.3: neue Seite Netzwerk-Diagnos: Version 7.3: New Network Diagnostics page (no IPv4 address/169.254, no internet: find the cause and repair it with one click, even offline), new Microsoft Surface page (model, firmware, driver package also for the USB drive, UEFI, battery, Type Cover, known issues), portable version with Netzwerk-Notfall.cmd
strings.Version 7.2: Treiber-Update-Center (NVID: Version 7.2: Driver update center (NVIDIA, Intel, Windows Update in one list), driver tools, driver store, history and backups; Updates page with status, program and Windows updates to choose from; Printers: clear and restart the queue with one button
strings.Version 7.1: Einrichtungs-Assistent mit: Version 7.1: Setup Assistant with a business step (domain, policies, Wi-Fi, VPN, proxy, certificates, inventory), greeting with the signed-in user's name, winget fixes (PowerToys, unknown versions, HWiNFO update)
strings.Version 7.0: Einrichtungs-Assistent (all: Version 7.0: Setup Assistant (everything in one pass, with update rounds across restarts), New Device Check with test report, automatic Windows installation via USB drive, custom program profiles
strings.Neu: Drucker und Scanner (vollständige H: New: Printers & Scanners (complete manufacturer drivers, troubleshooting), Network Security (find and close weak spots), vulnerabilities in programs, Update Control, Accounts & Network, Transfer Settings
strings.Neu: Hersteller-Treiberpaket (Lenovo/HP/: New: Manufacturer driver pack (Lenovo/HP/Dell), warranty display, remote jobs to other PCs, integration with Home Assistant (MQTT/REST) and RMM, new design with page icons and smooth transitions
strings.Version 6.1: neue Seite BIOS-Einstellung: Version 6.1: New BIOS Settings page for Lenovo, HP and Dell - read, change and back up all settings; quick toggles by topic; restart straight into the BIOS

strings.1. Akku vollständig auf 100 % laden und: 1. Charge the battery fully to 100% and then leave it plugged in for another 1-2 hours (the charging circuit balances the cells).
strings.2. Energiesparmodus so einstellen, dass: 2. Set the power options so the laptop does NOT hibernate when the battery is low (Control Panel > Power Options > Change plan settings > Change advanced power settings > Battery > Critical battery action: "Do nothing", or hibernate only at 3%).
strings.3. Netzteil abziehen und den Laptop norm: 3. Unplug the charger and use the laptop normally or just leave it on (screen on) until it shuts down by itself.
strings.4. Mindestens 3-5 Stunden ausgeschaltet: 4. Let it rest turned off for at least 3-5 hours.
strings.5. Ohne Unterbrechung wieder auf 100 % l: 5. Charge it back to 100% without interruption (ideally while turned off).
strings.6. Energieeinstellungen aus Schritt 2 wi: 6. Restore the power settings from step 2 and run the "Battery report" or the battery test here again.
strings.Hinweis: Kalibrieren repariert keinen ve: Note: calibrating doesn't fix a worn-out battery - it only makes the percentage and remaining time accurate again. Lithium batteries don't like deep discharges: calibrate at most every 2-3 months. Many manufacturers (Lenovo Vantage, Dell Power Manager, HP, Surface) have their own calibration or charge limit features - these take priority.

strings.Damit es klappt: 1) im BIOS/UEFI \"Wake: To make it work: 1) turn on "Wake on LAN" or "Power On by PCI-E" in the BIOS/UEFI, 2) in Device Manager, on the network adapter's Power Management tab, check "Allow this device to wake the computer" and "Only allow a magic packet to wake the computer", and on the Advanced tab enable "Wake on Magic Packet", 3) turn off Windows fast startup (otherwise the PC often won't wake up after "Shut down"). Wake-on-LAN usually doesn't work over Wi-Fi, only over a cable. From the internet: trigger it in the router (e.g. FRITZ!Box: Home Network > Network > device > "Start Computer").

"Apply" changes the DNS only for this PC's active adapter; the "Router" row sets it back to automatic.

Most common causes, in this order: a network filter from antivirus software (e.g. Panda NNSNAHSL), a disabled or misconfigured network service (from Windows 11 24H2 also WinHTTP Auto-Proxy), Hyper-V leftovers and broken TCP/IP entries. The profile "Reset network completely (Surface/DHCP problem)" above goes through all of these in the right order - the deep check below shows beforehand what stands out.
strings.Reihenfolge, wenn nichts anderes hilft:: Order if nothing else helps: 1. System Restore to a point before the problem, 2. Repair install (keeps programs and files), 3. Reset this PC (programs have to be reinstalled). Back up your data first (Backup page).

strings.Windows-Setup installiert Windows aus ei: Windows Setup installs Windows from an ISO over the existing Windows. strings.Automatisch neu starten, sobald Setup be: Restart automatically as soon as Setup is ready

strings.Die Registry ist die zentrale Einstellun: The registry is Windows' central settings database. When programs are uninstalled, they often leave behind references to files that no longer exist. These leftovers don't make your PC noticeably slower - anyone promising "faster PCs through registry cleaning" is exaggerating. But cleaning up does help against error messages ("File not found" at startup), dead entries in "Open with" and orphaned programs in the program list. PC-Tools only reports entries whose target is definitely missing on a fixed, existing drive; helper programs like rundll32 or msiexec, network drives and USB drives are never evaluated. Before every change, the affected key is backed up with reg.exe as a .reg file - no backup, no change. Every backup can be restored below with one click.
strings.SharedDLLs-Zähler für Dateien, die nicht: SharedDLLs counters for files that no longer exist (HKLM\...\SharedDLLs)
strings.App Paths: Kurzname (z.B. winword.exe) z: App Paths: short name (e.g. winword.exe) points to a missing file

strings.Registrierte Schriftarten, deren Datei f: Registered fonts whose file is missing

strings.Jede Reinigung legt einen Ordner unter D: Every cleaning creates a folder under data folder\Registry-Sicherung: the .reg files, Liste.txt (what was changed) and Wiederherstellen.cmd. "Restore" imports all .reg files of this backup again - deleted entries are back afterwards.
strings.Programme deinstallieren - und was übrig: Uninstall programs - and what's left behind
strings.Alle Desktop-Programme (für alle Benutze: All desktop programs (for all users, 32 and 64 bit, current user only) and Store apps in one list - search, sort by size or date. Uninstalling uses the vendor's uninstaller; "Quiet" uses its silent mode if available (for MSI packages msiexec /x ... /qn). Afterwards, PC-Tools searches specifically for leftovers: program folders in Program Files, ProgramData and AppData, plus settings in the registry (Software\Vendor\Product). Only what exactly matches the program name is found; folders go to the Recycle Bin, registry keys are backed up as .reg first. Orphaned entries (uninstaller missing) can be removed from the list with a backup.
strings.Findet Programme, die lange nicht gestar: Finds programs that haven't been started in a long time (Windows remembers program launches for all users). Runtimes, drivers, security, backup, VPN, remote support, Office and printer programs are never suggested. After a single confirmation, all checked programs are uninstalled silently one after another - with a restore point; leftovers (folders to the Recycle Bin, registry with backup) and orphaned shortcuts are removed at the same time.
strings.Programm auswählen - Details erscheinen: Select a program - details appear here.
strings.Nutzt den stillen Deinstallationsbefehl: Uses the vendor's silent uninstall command or msiexec /qn - without prompts. Without a silent command, the normal uninstaller opens.
strings.Erweiterungen können alles lesen, was Si: Extensions can read everything you see in the browser - including passwords as you type them. So check regularly whether you know and need every extension. PC-Tools reads Edge, Chrome, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera and Firefox in all profiles of all users. Extensions marked orange don't come from the official store (installed by programs, via policy or as a developer version) - a typical route for adware and spyware extensions. Removing: in Chromium browsers, the extension folder goes to the Recycle Bin while the browser is closed. If browser sync is on, the extension may come back - then also remove it in the browser itself. Remove Firefox extensions at about:addons.
strings.Sogenannte Browser-Hijacker verbiegen Su: So-called browser hijackers redirect the search engine and home page to ad sites - often via policy (then the browser shows "Managed by your organization"). Here you can see what each browser has set; anything unknown is marked orange. Display only - change the setting in the browser itself. If it says "set by policy" and your PC isn't managed by a company, the Policy column shows the value under HKLM/HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies.
strings.Viele Programme hängen sich ins Rechtskl: Many programs add themselves to File Explorer's right-click menu - the menu gets long and opens more slowly, and faulty extensions can even make File Explorer crash. Here you can see all third-party entries for files, folders, the folder background and drives. Hiding is always reversible: shell extensions go on Windows' official block list (Shell Extensions\Blocked), simple commands get the LegacyDisable value. Nothing is deleted. Changes take effect after restarting File Explorer. Windows entries are only shown on request - only hide what you're sure you don't need there.
strings.Windows 11 zeigt zuerst ein verkürztes M: Windows 11 first shows a shortened menu; most programs' entries are only under "Show more options" (Shift+F10). The switch for the classic, full menu is on the Tuning page (File Explorer and taskbar).
strings.Zum Schalter auf der Seite Tuning: Go to the switch on the Tuning page
strings.Neben dem Autostart nutzen viele Program: Besides startup apps, many programs use the Windows Task Scheduler: update checks every few hours, "helper programs" at every sign-in, telemetry - and sometimes malware that keeps restarting itself unnoticed this way. Here you'll find all tasks outside \Microsoft\ with vendor, trigger in plain language and action. Red = the program started no longer exists (leftover from an uninstall, safe to delete). Disabling can be undone at any time; before deleting, PC-Tools backs up the task as XML (data folder\Aufgaben-Sicherung - restore with schtasks /create /xml File /tn Name). PC-Tools' own tasks are protected; the full list including Windows tasks is in Computer Management > Task Scheduler.
strings.Gelöschte Dateien sind nicht wirklich we: Deleted files aren't really gone: Windows only frees up the space, and the content remains until it's overwritten - recovery programs can find it. Before selling or giving away a PC (or after deleting confidential files), "Overwrite free space" overwrites only the FREE space of a drive three times (zeros, ones, random numbers) with the Windows tool cipher /w. Existing files stay untouched; wiping entire drives is deliberately not offered here. On HDDs (hard drives with platters) this is effective but takes hours. On SSDs, the controller spreads writes across other cells, so overwriting doesn't reach all old data and costs lifespan. For SSDs, TRIM is the right way: it tells the SSD about all free areas, the SSD erases them internally, and afterwards most models return only zeros.
Select a drive in the list.
strings.Während des Überschreibens füllt cipher: While overwriting, cipher temporarily fills the drive almost completely (EFSTMPWP folder). Other programs may report during this time that there's no free space left - it's best to let it run overnight. You can cancel at any time (Log page); the space is then freed again immediately.
strings.Dauer: etwa dreimal so lange, wie das La: Duration: about three times as long as the drive takes to fill its free space - for an HDD with 500 GB free, roughly 3 to 4 hours.
strings.Ganzes Laufwerk vor dem Verkauf: Windows: Entire drive before selling: reset Windows with "Clean the drive" (Settings > System > Recovery), or for additional drives use Computer Management > Disk Management. For encrypted drives (BitLocker), deleting the key is enough.
strings.Gründliche Reinigung wie bei CCleaner Pr: Thorough cleaning like CCleaner Professional - but transparent and careful: browsers with all profiles, over 20 programs, Windows traces, orphaned registry entries (always with backup), uninstalling programs including leftovers, checking browser extensions and home pages, cleaning up the context menu and third-party scheduled tasks, and securely wiping free space. Analyze first, then clean - saved passwords are never touched.
strings.Misst den Zustand, setzt einen Wiederher: Measures the health, creates a restore point, cleans up, installs Windows, driver and program updates (drivers and BIOS version are backed up first), optimizes and checks the system, security and backup - and then shows everything in a before/after report.

Before every driver, BIOS or firmware update (Windows Update, NVIDIA, Intel, HP Image Assistant, Lenovo Thin Installer, Dell Command | Update, manufacturer driver pack, Surface package), PC-Tools automatically backs up all third-party drivers, records the version and date for each device as well as the BIOS version, and creates a restore point. strings.Alles rund um Strom: Zustand und Verschl: Everything about power: battery health and wear with history, estimated runtime, which programs drain the battery, why the PC won't sleep or wakes up at night, power plans and power mode, charge limit to protect the battery - and for desktop PCs, power-saving tips and the UPS.
strings.Gesundheit = heutige volle Kapazität get: Health = today's full charge capacity divided by the design capacity. Above 80 % is good, 60-80 % is worn (noticeably shorter runtime), below 60 % a replacement makes sense. Lithium batteries typically last 500-1000 charge cycles; one cycle is a full charge, even if spread out (2 x 50 % = 1 cycle). Heat and staying at 100 % do the most damage - the charge limit further down helps against that.
strings.Zwei Quellen: Windows zeichnet seit der: Two sources: since installation, Windows records the full charge capacity every week (powercfg /batteryreport), and PC-Tools also saves a daily data point (Device Health page). Windows' runtime estimate is based on the average consumption on battery over the last few weeks.
strings.Windows protokolliert ständig, wie viel: Windows constantly logs how much energy each program uses - split into processor, display, network and disk (System Resource Usage Monitor, SRUM). The analysis shows the biggest consumers of the last few days, even when plugged in.
strings.Windows beobachtet eine Minute lang Proz: For one minute, Windows monitors the processor, timers, USB devices, drivers and power settings and reports everything that wastes power (powercfg /energy). During the measurement, avoid using the PC if possible and close unnecessary programs.
strings.Programme, Dienste und Treiber, die Wind: Programs, services and drivers that are currently asking Windows to stay awake or keep the screen on (powercfg /requests). Video playback and downloads are normal - an entry that stays here permanently is the reason the PC won't go to sleep.
strings.Aufgaben, die den PC zu einer bestimmten: Tasks that are allowed to wake the PC from sleep at a specific time - usually Windows Update or maintenance. Wake timers can be turned off on the Personalize page ("Allow wake timers").
strings.Geräte, die den PC wecken dürfen: Devices allowed to wake the PC
strings.Maus, Tastatur und Netzwerkkarte dürfen: Mouse, keyboard and network adapter are often allowed to wake the PC from sleep. If the laptop wakes up in your bag or the PC wakes at night for no reason, block waking for the culprit here (usually the mouse or network adapter).
strings.Wann der PC zuletzt aus dem Standby oder: When the PC last woke from sleep or hibernation, and what caused it (event log).
strings.Bei Modern Standby (S0) zeigt Windows fü: With Modern Standby (S0), Windows shows for each sleep session how much battery it used and which programs or devices prevented deep sleep (powercfg /sleepstudy). For classic sleep (S3), there is the System Sleep Diagnostics instead.
strings.Fertig abgestimmte Pläne auf Basis von \: Ready-made plans based on "Balanced" - Windows updates and drivers are not affected, and the plan can be deleted at any time.
strings.Der Schieberegler aus Einstellungen > Sy: The slider from Settings > System > Power & battery: sets how much Windows favors performance or efficiency. It only takes effect while the "Balanced" plan is active (custom plans bring their own settings).
strings.Dimmt den Bildschirm, bremst Hintergrund: Dims the screen and limits background apps and syncing. Turns on automatically on battery once the charge drops to an adjustable level.
strings.Ein Lithium-Akku altert am schnellsten,: A lithium battery ages fastest when it's constantly at 100 % and warm - typical for laptops that are mostly plugged in or docked. A charge limit of 60-80 % can double its lifespan. Before a trip, just set it back to 100 % for a while.
strings.Eine über USB angeschlossene USV meldet: A UPS connected via USB shows up in Windows like a battery. Windows then shuts down the PC on its own during a power outage as soon as the set critical charge level is reached - no manufacturer software needed.

strings.ThinkPad: Die Meldung \"The connected AC: ThinkPad: The message "The connected AC adapter has a lower wattage than the recommended AC adapter" comes directly from the firmware when the power adapter reports less power than the original (usually 65 W on T480/T490). Many ThinkPads have no setting for it - if no matching setting is shown here, it can't be turned off. Fix: USB-C power adapter with at least 65 W and Power Delivery, a different cable (some cables only handle 3 A/60 W), a dock with enough power, update the BIOS. With a power adapter that's too weak, the battery charges slowly or not at all.
strings.Dell: \"Warnungen und Fehler\" (Warnings: Dell: Set "Warnings and Errors" (WarningsAndErr) to "Continue on Warnings and Errors" - then the PC no longer stops on warnings (e.g. power adapter too weak). Where available, "Adapter Warnings" turns off the power adapter message completely.

strings.Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi und Opera v: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi and Opera encrypt saved passwords with this PC's Windows account - copied over, they can't be read on the new PC. That's why PC-Tools uses the browser's export feature: press the button, choose "Export passwords" in the browser, confirm with your Windows password or PIN, and paste the folder when saving (Ctrl+V - it's already on the clipboard). When creating the package, the CSV files go into the migration package. Firefox takes its passwords along with the profile anyway.

strings.Die wichtigsten Einstellungen, sortiert: The most important settings, sorted by topic. Only what your model actually has in its BIOS is shown. Change them, then click "Apply changes" below - takes effect after the next restart.
strings.Findet Dienste mit Starttyp Automatisch,: Finds services with startup type Automatic that aren't running and tells you WHY (dependency, startup type, account, disabled, error code). "Repair" sets core services to Windows defaults, starts dependencies in the right order and starts the services. Services that only start when needed (trigger) are recognized as normal.
strings.Findet Geräte mit Ausrufezeichen im Gerä: Finds devices with an exclamation mark in Device Manager and tells you what's wrong. "Repair" removes orphaned entries (e.g. an old TAP/VPN adapter whose driver was deleted) and turns off Bluetooth services without drivers (e.g. for paired phones/tablets under "Other devices") for their device - so they don't come back.
strings.Findet Store-Apps (z.B. das neue Outlook: Finds Store apps (e.g. the new Outlook) that are registered but whose program folder is missing - typical after major Windows updates. Also checks damaged app runtimes and WebView2. "Repair" removes broken Store apps and opens their Store page for reinstalling; broken runtimes and WebView2 are reinstalled.
strings.Häkchen entfernen = Programm startet nic: Uncheck = program no longer starts with Windows (like in Task Manager, reversible anytime). Takes effect immediately. Entries marked with the pin always stay on with "Only what's needed" and "All off".
strings.Keine IPv4-Adresse, obwohl die DHCP-Anfr: No IPv4 address even though the DHCP request goes out and no response comes back (IPv6 works)? Most common causes in this order: an antivirus network filter (e.g. Panda NNSNAHSL), a disabled or misconfigured network service (since Windows 11 24H2 also WinHTTP Auto-Proxy), Hyper-V leftovers and broken TCP/IP entries. The "Full network reset (Surface/DHCP problem)" profile above goes through all of these in the right order - the deep check below shows beforehand what stands out.
strings.Mit dem Laptop von Raum zu Raum gehen, R: Walk from room to room with the laptop, enter the room name and click "Measure here" (10 seconds: signal, access point, speed, ping to the router). The list goes into the network report and shows where a repeater is missing.
